notes: Accessibility and usability update: the main menu is grouped under headings (Today, Clients, Services, Equipment, Billing, compliance & reports, Help & account) and every menu link has a short hint read after a pause; breadcrumb navigation on staff pages; collapsed forms keep a findable heading; staff shortcuts no longer shown on client pages. Busy pages are easier to use: Log a session near the top of each training track, lists before add-forms, a grouped Daily action center, Templates split into four libraries, equipment search and filters, a Reports list, audit log filters. Clients see a referral number and expected contact date, clearer expired-link messages and plainer wording. The voice assistant never saves a waiting change after an unclear answer. No database migration: sites on 3.0.21 update application files only. Sites on 3.0.16 to 3.0.20 apply mig_3.0.21.sql first. Older sites apply mig_3.0.8, 3.0.9, 3.0.10, 3.0.12, 3.0.16 and 3.0.21 in order; all are safe to re-run.
